subject: physics
content: Two coherent monochromatic point sources and of wavelength are placed symmetrically on either side of the center of the circle as shown. The sources are separated by a distance This arrangement produces interference fringes visible as alternate bright and dark spots on the circumference of the circle. The angular separation between two consecutive bright spots is Which of the following options is/are correct?

options.content:
The angular separation between two consecutive
bright spots decreases as we move from P<sub>1</sub> to P<sub>2</sub> along
the first quadrant.
At P<sub>2</sub> the order of the fringe will be maximum.
A dark spot will be formed at the point P<sub>2</sub>.

The total number of fringes produced between P<sub>1</sub> and
P<sub>2</sub> in the first quadrant is close to 3000.

explanation:
At any point P on circumference, the path difference, x = d sin

At P1, = 0 x = 0

At P2, = 90 x = d

For constructive interference, x = n

Since, n is integer, hence P2 corresponds to bright spot and also it corresponds to maximum order of fringe.

Now, x = d sin

dx = d cos d or R = d cos d

Hence, as increases, cos decreases and consequently d increases.
